T: Jazz club. Chicken on a Stick.
D: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles.
P: Serve the drinks when Sebastian takes Mia to the jazz club.
S: Warm olives, almonds and parmesan crisps
Olives with orange and fennel, rosemary almonds, baked parmesan rounds
Olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel and fennel seed, almonds roasted at 170C with rosemary and salt, and parmesan crisps baked in little rounds at 190C for 6 minutes.
Someone in the Crowd smash sliders
thin patties pressed on a hot griddle, caramelised onion and cheddar, while Seb plays keytar

Thin beef patties smashed on a smoking griddle with caramelised onion, cheddar, pickles and a spicy burger sauce on toasted brioche slider buns. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 20 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp sriracha and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Smash thin on a smoking hot pan, salt, cook 90 seconds, flip, top with cheddar and onions and cook 1 minute. Toast 12 brioche slider buns, spread with sauce and add a patty and pickles.
M: Chicken on a Stick, Korean BBQ skewers
thighs glazed in gochujang, soy and honey, charred over high heat, rice and kimchi slaw

Chicken thighs on skewers glazed in gochujang, soy and honey, charred LA street-cart style, with steamed rice, kimchi slaw and sesame. Mix 3 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp sesame oil and 2 grated garlic cloves. Toss 1kg diced chicken thighs in half the mix for 1 hour, then thread onto skewers. Grill over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with the rest. Toss shredded cabbage with 100g chopped kimchi and lime. Serve on rice with spring onion and sesame seeds.
Tarragon butter roast chicken, silky mashed potatoes, Dijon-dressed leaves
Chicken roasted at 220C with tarragon butter pushed under the skin, rested, carved, with silky pommes purée and a green salad with Dijon vinaigrette.
W: Dark chocolate ganache tart with flaky salt and edible gold stars
Sweet pastry blind baked at 180C, filled with a dark chocolate ganache set for 3 hours, finished with flaky salt and a scatter of edible gold stars.
Day-old croissants filled with almond cream and baked with flaked almonds
Mini almond croissants: day-old croissants split, filled with almond cream, topped with flaked almonds, baked at 180C for 15 minutes, icing sugar dusted.
K: Bourbon, sugar cube and bitters stirred over a big cube with orange peel
60ml bourbon stirred with a sugar cube, 2 dashes of bitters and ice for 30 seconds, strained over a big cube, orange peel twisted over.

s.n: Warm olives, almonds and parmesan crisps
s.note: Olives with orange and fennel, rosemary almonds, baked parmesan rounds
s.how: Warm 250g olives in oil with orange peel and fennel seeds. Roast 150g almonds at 170C with rosemary and salt. Bake small rounds of 100g grated parmesan at 190C for 6 minutes. Serve in little bowls.

m.note: Tarragon butter roast chicken, silky mashed potatoes, Dijon-dressed leaves
m.how: Push 60g butter mixed with tarragon under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken and roast at 220C then 180C for 70 minutes. Rest and carve. Mash 1kg potatoes with 100g butter until silky. Serve with leaves in Dijon vinaigrette.

w.note: Dark chocolate ganache tart with flaky salt and edible gold stars
w.how: Blind-bake a tart tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust at 180C. Pour in 250g dark chocolate melted into 250ml cream and set 3 hours. Finish with flaky salt and a scatter of edible gold stars.

w.note: Day-old croissants filled with almond cream and baked with flaked almonds
w.how: Beat 60g butter, 60g sugar, 60g almond meal and an egg. Split 4 day-old croissants, fill with almond cream, top with flaked almonds and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Bourbon, sugar cube and bitters stirred over a big cube with orange peel
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon with a sugar cube and 2 dashes aromatic bitters over ice for 30 seconds. Strain over a big cube and twist orange peel over the top. Makes four.
